# SalesHunter Coach v0.23.1 — Official SalesHunter Brand & App Icon

This release delivers the new official visual identity and branded icon system for SalesHunter Coach, replacing the legacy upstream placeholder icons across macOS, Windows, and mobile targets.

### New Features & Visual Polish

- **Official SalesHunter Brand Icon**: Precision hunter reticle fused with live audio coaching soundwave pulses in obsidian dark glassmorphic squircle with Apple HIG-compliant drop shadow and brushed bezel.
- **macOS DMG & Application Bundle Icon**: High-resolution 1024x1024 multi-tier `.icns` asset embedded across all desktop distributions.
- **Universal Assets**: Generated high-res assets across Windows (`icon.ico`), macOS (`icon.icns`, `icon.png`), and web/vector SVG representations.
